findings.highlight: the pain from my stomach
findings.evidenceJa: 腹の痛み
findings.governingReading: pain in his abdomen
findings.explanation: The location of Assassin’s blow and Shirou’s injury is moved from the abdominal wall to the stomach organ.

findings.highlight: Instinctively, I know what that means
findings.evidenceJa: 考えなくても判っていた
findings.governingReading: in truth, he already understood without needing to think further
findings.explanation: A grief-stricken recognition he has effectively already reached becomes an undefined instinct.

findings.highlight: There’s no enmity coming from Rider
findings.evidenceJa: ライダーに殺気はない
findings.governingReading: Rider is emitting no murderous intent
findings.explanation: The immediate judgment that Rider does not intend to kill him is weakened into an absence of general hostility.

findings.highlight: she actually came to help me
findings.evidenceJa: 俺を助けただけのようだった
findings.governingReading: it seems she genuinely did nothing more than help him
findings.explanation: The English adds a purpose for Rider’s arrival rather than limiting the observation to what she actually did.

findings.highlight: why am I taking my time?
findings.evidenceJa: どうしてこんな、寄り道をしているのか
findings.governingReading: why is he making this detour when he wants to reach Saber
findings.explanation: Shirou’s self-reproach for diverting into a question is changed into moving too slowly.

findings.highlight: I don’t believe her
findings.evidenceJa: 納得できないし信じられないが
findings.governingReading: although he can neither make sense of it nor believe it
findings.explanation: One of Shirou’s two reservations about Rider’s answer disappears.

findings.highlight: The whole place is destroyed as if a storm passed by
findings.evidenceJa: 廊下は所々がヤスリをかけたように削がれ、半壊している
findings.governingReading: the corridor is half-destroyed, scraped away in places as though by a file
findings.explanation: Localized patterned damage is inflated into total destruction of the whole site, while the filed-away surface image is lost.

findings.highlight: I can’t tell whose blood this is
findings.evidenceJa: 手の平よりも小さな血痕
findings.governingReading: a bloodstain smaller than his palm, whose owner he cannot identify
findings.explanation: The tiny scale that makes Shirou’s certainty emotionally revealing rather than evidential is omitted.

findings.highlight: she merely answered me
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女もそれに応えてくれていた
findings.governingReading: she had answered or responded to his taking her hand
findings.explanation: Saber’s reciprocal acceptance of their knowingly lethal contract is narrowed toward a verbal reply and made dismissive by “merely.”

findings.highlight: she simply nodded, ignoring the premonitions of her end
findings.evidenceJa: 終わりの予感を堪えて、俺の意見に頷いてくれた
findings.governingReading: she bore the foreboding of an ending and assented to his judgment
findings.explanation: Saber’s conscious endurance and costly loyalty become passive disregard, while “simply” minimizes her choice.

findings.highlight: lost my rights as a Master
findings.evidenceJa: マスターでなくなって
findings.governingReading: ceased to be a Master or lost his qualification as one
findings.explanation: The technical status change is framed as loss of unspecified rights.

findings.highlight: back to being just an amateur
findings.evidenceJa: 元の半人前に戻った
findings.governingReading: returned to being the same incomplete or half-fledged practitioner as before
findings.explanation: Shirou’s self-description as unfinished and inadequate is generalized into amateur status.

findings.highlight: I slowly rub the bloodstain one last time
findings.evidenceJa: 最後に長く、血の跡に指を這わせた
findings.governingReading: one last time, he traces his finger over the stain for a long while
findings.explanation: The austere sustained farewell gesture is changed from tracing to rubbing, and duration is reassigned as movement speed.

findings.highlight: Pain assails my left hand, and it disappears
findings.evidenceJa: 一際強く左手が痛み、消えた
findings.governingReading: his left hand hurts with exceptional force, and then the Command Spells vanish
findings.explanation: The dangling pronoun grammatically makes the left hand itself the most immediate disappearing referent.

findings.highlight: The Command Spell on my left hand disappears without trace
findings.evidenceJa: 左手の令呪は、跡形も無く消え去っていった
findings.governingReading: the Command Spells on his left hand vanish without a trace
findings.explanation: The visible set of marks is singularized, weakening consistency with the following Master-qualification rule.

findings.highlight: lost my rights as a Master
findings.evidenceJa: この瞬間になくした
findings.governingReading: lost his qualification as a Master at this very moment
findings.explanation: The timing that connects the vanished marks to Shirou’s present status realization is omitted.

findings.highlight: All of Rider’s words tonight
findings.evidenceJa: ライダーの言動
findings.governingReading: Rider’s words and behavior
findings.explanation: The unexpected pattern includes both what Rider says and does; the English removes her actions.

findings.highlight: This is my personal choice
findings.evidenceJa: これは私個人の感情です
findings.governingReading: this is my personal feeling
findings.explanation: Rider’s admission of personal emotion beyond orders becomes a deliberate but emotionally neutral choice.

findings.highlight: It is a whim of mine, nothing more
findings.evidenceJa: ただそう思っただけですので、他意はありません
findings.governingReading: she merely felt she should do so and has no ulterior intent
findings.explanation: A careful assurance of sincerity is recast as caprice, weakening Rider’s guarded act of concern.

findings.highlight: I can’t get further in debt to you
findings.evidenceJa: そこまで世話にはなれない
findings.governingReading: he cannot accept that much care or assistance from her
findings.explanation: The refusal to rely further on an enemy is turned into a financial or transactional debt metaphor.

findings.highlight: First of all, I never said I’m out of this war
findings.evidenceJa: まだ戦うつもりも何も
findings.governingReading: as for whether he still intends to fight, he has never said he would withdraw
findings.explanation: The opening dismissal of Rider’s premise is omitted and replaced by an unsupported discourse marker.

findings.highlight: Then please be careful on your way home
findings.evidenceJa: せいぜい、道中気をつけなさい
findings.governingReading: then do your utmost to watch yourself on the way
findings.explanation: Rider’s cool, faintly barbed imperative is softened into a polite well-wish.

findings.highlight: she looks so defenseless
findings.evidenceJa: 俺でも呆れるほど無防備だった
findings.governingReading: her back is defenseless enough to astonish even Shirou
findings.explanation: The degree and Shirou’s surprise at a hostile Servant exposing her back disappear.

findings.highlight: Thanks
findings.evidenceJa: さんきゅ
findings.governingReading: a clipped, casual “Thanky” or “Thanks”
findings.explanation: The English is semantically adequate but loses the conspicuously abbreviated, awkward delivery that helps explain Rider’s surprise.

findings.highlight: It’s awkward to stare at her straight on
findings.evidenceJa: まっすぐ向き合うのも気まずい
findings.governingReading: it is awkward to face her directly
findings.explanation: The social discomfort of squarely facing Rider becomes prolonged visual staring.

findings.highlight: I avert my gaze
findings.evidenceJa: わずかに視線を逸らす
findings.governingReading: he averts his gaze slightly
findings.explanation: The restrained degree of Shirou’s embarrassment is omitted.

findings.highlight: So I have to at least thank you
findings.evidenceJa: せめて礼ぐらい言っとかないとおまえに悪い
findings.governingReading: otherwise he would be doing Rider wrong if he failed even to thank her
findings.explanation: The ethical reason Shirou feels he owes acknowledgment to an enemy is removed.

findings.highlight: With those cold, emotionless words
findings.evidenceJa: 感情のない声で告げて
findings.governingReading: she states it in an emotionless voice
findings.explanation: The English adds coldness to the content itself, simplifying the tension between Rider’s personal concern and affectless delivery.

findings.highlight: I start walking after Rider disappears
findings.evidenceJa: 独り、ライダーの姿が見えなくなってから歩き出す
findings.governingReading: alone, Shirou starts walking only after Rider is out of sight
findings.explanation: The solitude beginning his forced hour of grief suppression is omitted.
